intro: Kenya has about 56 million people from over 40 ethnic groups.

chapters.title: Many peoples
text: The largest groups include the Kikuyu, Luhya, Kalenjin, Luo and Kamba; the Maasai are famous worldwide. English and Swahili are official languages. Most people are Christian, with a Muslim minority mainly on the coast.

chapters.title: Nairobi
text: Nairobi is a fast-growing capital and a hub for the UN and technology. Kibera is one of Africa's largest informal settlements.

keyTerms.meaning: A crowded area of homes built without formal planning.
